fields.label: Require Email Verification
fields.description: Signups must open the emailed link before the tenant is created. When off, the email is trusted as typed; the owner still sets a password from the welcome email, so only the real mailbox owner can log in.

fields.label: Require Phone Verification
fields.description: Signups must confirm an SMS one-time code before the tenant is created. Signup is refused while this is on and BulkSMSBD is not configured.

fields.label: Require Captcha
fields.description: Signup is refused while this is on and no captcha verifier is configured.

fields.label: reCAPTCHA Type
fields.description: v2 Checkbox shows "I'm not a robot". v3 Invisible needs no click and scores each signup. Each type needs its own key pair from the reCAPTCHA admin console.

fields.label: reCAPTCHA v3 Minimum Score
fields.description: 0.0 (likely bot) to 1.0 (likely human). Signups scoring below this are refused.

fields.label: Signup Rate Limits
fields.description: Requests allowed per IP address per hour; failed attempts count too. Set 0 to fall back to site config or the built-in default (signup 5, verification 20). Use Reset Rate Limits to clear the current counters.

fields.label: Signup Attempts per Hour
fields.description: Each completed signup creates a Company, so keep this low on a public site.

fields.label: Verification Requests per Hour
fields.description: Email link, SMS code and resend requests.
